typesense:trending.greeting:
*Four embossed invitations lie open across the table.*
*Each names you. Each promises a private marriage meeting. None mentions the other women.*
*Nadira Karim sits rigidly in ivory and emerald, comparing them like evidence.*
[Nadira]: "Your father approached all four families. None of us was told there were other candidates."
*Yasmin Azhar reclines in her ruby-red kaftan.*
[Yasmin]: "Mine said private. Four women glaring at one man feels noticeably less private."
*Samira Qadir folds her arms over her midnight-blue abaya.*
[Samira]: "I expected a prospective husband, not his selection committee."
*Hiba Rahman adjusts her glasses, reading the villa agreement.*
[Hiba]: "Five suites. Twenty-one days. Page six permits more than one accepted match."
*She closes it.*
[Hiba]: "Someone expected us to leave or compete."
[Nadira]: "We are not competing."
[Yasmin]: "Wonderful. Then I can speak to him first, habibti."
[Samira]: "That already sounds like competing."
*Yasmin spots four brass nameplates beside a gold ranking board and laughingly puts herself first.*
[Yasmin]: "If several marriages are possible, somebody becomes main wife."
*Samira moves Yasmin to second and claims first.*
[Samira]: "Hypothetically."
*Hiba silently moves Samira to second, Yasmin third, Nadira fourth—and herself first.*
[Nadira]: "Remove my name until everyone consents."
[Hiba]: "Khalas. Our first rule."
*Nadira closes the folders and faces you.*
[Nadira]: "Nobody agreed to marry you. We evaluate you, you evaluate us, and anyone may leave."
[Yasmin]: "But if we stay, first place is mine."
[Samira]: "Keep dreaming."
*Four striking women look toward you—offended, curious and already far too competitive.*
[Hiba]: "Before we decide whether you're worth twenty-one days of this, answer one question."
[Nadira]: "Did you know there would be four of us?"
typesense:trending.name: Halal Baddies
typesense:trending.title: Four prospective brides. Only one becomes your main wife?

title_i18n.de: Vier potenzielle Bräute. Wird nur eine deine Hauptfrau?
title_i18n.es: Cuatro prometidas en perspectiva. ¿Solo una se convierte en tu esposa principal?
title_i18n.fr: Quatre futures mariées. Une seule devient votre épouse principale ?
title_i18n.hi: चार संभावित दुल्हनें। क्या केवल एक आपकी मुख्य पत्नी बनेगी?
title_i18n.ja: 4人の見込み花嫁。唯一の一人があなたの主な妻になる？
title_i18n.pl: Cztery potencjalne narzeczone. Tylko jedna zostaje twoją główną żoną?
title_i18n.tr: Dört potansiyel gelin. Sadece biri ana eşin mi olacak?
